behavior: FIRST_JOB exceptions with exact failed cleaned receipts create one durable packet tied to original cursor, failed phase/receipt, Store and initial request. Missing receipts/unknown effects/STOP cannot authorize retries.

One read-only disposition model is charged and deduplicated per failure packet. It can request an existing independent initial-review replacement, a bounded CPU timeout replacement, or a post-analysis decision replacement.
Analysis timeout must increase within 3600 seconds and the original receipt must prove timeout; unrelated nonzero failures cannot be repaired by changing timeouts.
Original attempts and charges remain. Crash after replacement registration reuses the exact intent and restores FIRST_JOB without repeating the model or submitting a job.
Validated preflight reviews and pre-analysis repair dispositions are distinguished from downstream consumption when checking analysis replacement eligibility.
REPAIR_CODE_REQUIRED/EXTERNAL_BLOCKER preserve actionable findings and return without extra calls; this module is not a code writer.
boundaries: Real local fake CLI and CPU child processes; prior initial-review receipt/production runtime/science use explicit fixtures.
Initial Store fixture prevents live Popen; only exact CPU model-worker subprocess commands are allowed by the scoped test adapter.
Controller first-run routing tests substitute the live runner; no deployment, GPU probe, baseline, training or scientific acceptance.
Concrete code repair, offline/control/frozen-phase repair and failed disposition recovery remain separate event-triggered work.
